games.title: Kota Chomp DX
games.note: Dumpster level, the third line on the title screen: the ledge round the rim. Walking into its side costs a heart and bounces you; jumping onto it works, and the whole jump arc now plays out before the cat lands instead of just the landing half appearing. The take-off window is three columns wide - nearer and you land short against the side, further and you overshoot onto the outer column and smack the rim. Nothing in the art says where that window is yet, so the thing to judge is whether it reads fairly. Walking off the inner edge dips the cat for about a beat. Evolved, the window is one block a side.

games.title: My Platformer
games.note: Wall jumps and ledge hang: on a wall in the air, press A to jump off it (hold towards one wall and tap A each time you touch it to climb it). Fall past a wall's top edge holding towards it to hang: Up climbs on, A jumps, Down lets go. Try pillars 5 and 6 and the shaft behind the hanging block in the Playtest Room. Aiming: B fires the plug or pellet ahead, Up + B straight up, Up + Left/Right + B diagonally up.
